Interface UI

All Known Implementing Classes:
GUI, TUI
public interface UI
Interface representing the User Interface (UI) component of the application. It provides methods to interact with the user across different stages of the game, such as player setup, building phase, flight phase, and end game scenarios. It's implemented by TUI and GUI
